scenarios.name: bff_unavailable_api_reachable
scenarios.observed: When the BFF is unavailable, the backend remains reachable and independent service health is isolated to the BFF boundary without degrading unrelated backend APIs.

scenarios.name: api_unavailable_bff_reports_dependency_failure
scenarios.observed: When the backend dependency is unavailable, the BFF surfaces a bounded 503/401 path without serving stale authenticated data or masking backend failures.

scenarios.name: worker_unavailable_api_remains_ready
scenarios.observed: Worker outage does not block API readiness or browser-facing session flows; the API remains responsive and the BFF continues to mediate requests with fail-closed semantics.
